scope: First fixed-policy early-revaluation PRICE PROXY; not fundamental valuation or live authorization
instrument: Unlevered USDT spot; no borrowing; actual funding cost is zero

universe.source: all discoverable historical Binance USDT archive directories including ended markets

execution.weekly: completed Sunday signal, Monday observation, Tuesday D+2 open
execution.missing_held: mark at prior price at open, no executable quote, full writeoff at close; other observable symbols remain executable
execution.gap_stop: worse of stop and opening price
execution.partial_profit: half at inherited 3R, stop first if both touched
execution.add: 14 days held and >=1 initial R profit, no extension, same risk cap
execution.exit: risk off, below SMA50 after seven days, or time limit; delayed weekly plan

evaluation: Continuous account plus independent calendar-year forward folds with preceding-history warmup. Fixed rules; no fitted parameters or hindsight-selected winner. Reset folds are diagnostics and never stitched.

minimum_cashflow_target_gates.interpretation: necessary historical research hurdle for 5m KRW on 20m capital, not a promise of monthly withdrawals or a confidence guarantee

decision: REJECTED if observed strategy fails empirical gates; NEEDS MORE EVIDENCE if empirical gates pass but coverage/chronology/forward evidence unresolved; PASSED only means specified research test passed and never live approval
forbidden: retuning v1 after inspecting its results
calling leveraged spot-return multiples futures returns
uncertainty: Already-known historical period, incomplete migration identities and archive coverage, no order-book replay, no taxes or KRW/USDT conversion. 3%/15% are triggers, not guaranteed maximum losses.
